status: Owner-selected intended playable roster. Only Wren, Tobin and Pip are currently implemented starters.

existing.name: Wren Hollowmere
existing.decision: Holding a Mark supports resource income; spending it changes the payoff. Wounds offer a separate route.

existing.name: Tobin Reed
existing.decision: Spend Grit on protection or reserve it for a decisive sword response; timing remains manual.

existing.name: Pip Cinderly
existing.decision: Early detonation sacrifices future fire ticks. Every release clears the consumed source.

existing.name: Old Hesketh
existing.decision: A protected low-oil rhythm competes with spending the prepared lamp for immediate pressure.

existing.name: Bram Hollis
existing.decision: Spend early to brace, aim for the exact-three Grain cut or reserve five for a larger fall.

existing.name: Maren Ashvale
existing.decision: Retain Ward to sustain sword work or surrender protection for rebuke; manual defence funds remembrance.

existing.name: Ser Aldric Vane
existing.decision: Declare a commitment, fulfil it on another chosen action or release the vow for safety.

existing.name: Kestrel Thane
existing.decision: Keep Long reach for penetration or enter Close for protected haft contact, then pay to step out.

existing.name: Thessaly Gloam
existing.decision: Retain a reading for protection or release it into reflection damage; cold adds a different control route.

existing.name: Grenna Holt
existing.decision: Open intact defences first or build Load for an impact while the foe is already open.

existing.name: Isolde Marrow
existing.decision: Let a contract wound accrue, close the Seal for an opening or preserve wounds while controlling the foe.

existing.name: Oriel Vess
existing.decision: Schedule one impact and wait, pull it early at reduced strength or cancel it for protection.

existing.name: Saint Elowen
existing.decision: Use a steady small-light window or hold a brighter reserve for a costly burst.

existing.name: Caedmon the Unburnt
existing.decision: Hold Heat for offensive pressure, risk opening the plate or vent the reserve into safety; being hit is never required.

existing.name: Corvin Black
existing.decision: Prepare an Opening, spend it on an answer or refuse it to recover Freedom.

existing.name: Cass Penhallow
existing.decision: Keep venom and the sounding mark working or consume setup for penetration and safer follow-up.

existing.name: Linnet Cole
existing.decision: Leave Chill to mature into control or anneal a layer into an opening; preserve or spend protective glass.

existing.name: Eskil Hauk
existing.decision: Keep Pin while poison works or consume the sign for a clear shot; poison stacks have finite duration.

existing.name: Brynja Berg
existing.decision: Keep the shield planted for protection or surrender the position and its Guard to release a heavier sword strike.

existing.name: Inga Fallow
existing.decision: Preserve Sunder for penetration or spend an exposed layer to excavate cold underneath.

existing.name: Ragna Vik
existing.decision: Let venom mature, reduce it for damage or dilute it for cover while buying separate frost treatment.

additions.name: Nerys Fleet
additions.title: The Foxstep Archer
additions.remainingWork: Rework bow into a clear shortbow; ready pose uses one hand at the central grip, with the other free. Continuous straight undrawn string tip-to-tip, rendered visibly across the body. Preserve the character direction.

additions.name: Mab Vale
additions.title: The Threadbinder
additions.remainingWork: Preserve the liked spindle/thread design. Broaden ethnicity and facial diversity across future additions; do not recolour existing approved characters to satisfy a quota.

additions.name: Peregrine Clocks
additions.title: The Watchmaker
additions.remainingWork: Preserve elderly identity and skin tone; revise head hair to short tightly coiled silver hair and beard to an appropriately textured close silver beard. Match both views.

additions.name: Tamsin Rook
additions.title: The Bellsword
additions.remainingWork: Preserve the liked core design and scar/undercut identity; earlier unwanted quiver and warblade compatibility still need attention.

additions.name: Sable Quill
additions.title: The Ash Reader
additions.remainingWork: Preserve the strongly liked face, colours and costume. Earlier reviewer suggestions do not override this direct feedback; any ledger/focus change must preserve the identity the owner likes.

additions.name: Ione Hart
additions.title: The Prism Warden
additions.remainingWork: Retain Ione. Refine the prism staff head into a coherent glass focus and redesign the tome with clear broad fire/cold prism motifs, matching the focus detail.

additions.name: Adela Wych
additions.title: The Pale Advocate
additions.remainingWork: Retain Adela. Refine the closed-arch staff head while preserving the liked overall design and violet lantern.

additions.name: Ysabet Fen
additions.title: The Winter Arrow
additions.remainingWork: Retain Ysabet. Rebuild bow with coherent symmetric limb geometry, central grip and a continuous tip-to-tip string; ensure the bow remains in front of the body.

additions.name: Eamon Grey
additions.title: The Road Duellist
additions.remainingWork: Retain Eamon as a viable candidate; no additional owner correction specified.

additions.name: Celandine Orr
additions.title: The Dawn Surgeon
additions.remainingWork: Retain the holy-mage direction and anatomical tome/split-circle identity.

additions.name: Flint Mercer
additions.title: The Stormwright
additions.remainingWork: Preserve stocky build, not a deliberately short stature. Reduce oversized boots and restore balanced head/body/foot proportions.

additions.name: Merrick Low
additions.title: The Quiet Hunter
additions.remainingWork: Rebuild bow geometry and place the hand at its central grip. Continuous correctly attached straight undrawn string.

additions.name: Gideon March
additions.title: The Gate Interceptor
additions.remainingWork: Retain as a viable design candidate; no additional owner correction specified.
